neighbours.label: the adjective ' vast' (vast holdings, a vast majority)
fire: The museum keeps its vast collection of maps in the basement.
Over the years she built a vast network of contacts.
Explorers crossed the vast plains on horseback.
The company sits on a vast pile of unused data.
Our town library lent out its vast archive of photographs.
A vast majority of voters supported the new park.
The ship sailed across the vast ocean for weeks.
He inherited a vast estate in the countryside.
